omm_stream.AckContribResponse

Response of a contribution that was acknowledged by the server with an Ack message. A NAK code in the message marks the contribution as unsuccessful.

Available as lseg.data.delivery.omm_stream.AckContribResponse.

Syntax

AckContribResponse(message: dict)

Parameters

Parameter Type Required Default Description
message dict Yes Message received from the server.

Properties

Property Description
ack_id Acknowledgement ID of the contribution, if present in the message.
debug Debug information from the message, empty if absent.
error Always empty.
is_success True if the acknowledgement has no NAK code.
nak_code Negative acknowledgement code from the message, empty if absent.
nak_message Text of the negative acknowledgement, empty if absent.
type Type of the response message.
